_note: Paths for scripts/tailor_cv.py, the local CV tailor that writes from private/experience_bank.yaml. A path belongs to a track (A = Commercial, B = Research; see cv-variant.js). The printed variants in cv-data.json and the Workshop are separate and unchanged. Skills rows come from cv-data.json, reordered (rows not listed are dropped) and with the additions below; the model never writes skills. A path's headline is cv-data.json taglines.<tagline>, shared with the Workshop.

A.label: Commercial: product & commercial analytics
A.useFor: Product data science, commercial or marketing analytics, insight analytics, BI-with-strategy roles.
A.summaryOpener: Data analyst and behavioural economist with 6+ years
A.summaryBrief: Open with exactly "Data analyst and behavioural economist with 6+ years", then adapt to the job from bank facts: retail, media and global operations; experimentation, SQL and Python, reliable pipelines; turning user and customer behaviour into product and commercial decisions.
A._excludeNote: Bank entries left out unless the job description matches the pattern (case-insensitive).
A.dissertationBrief: At most two bullets in the Research section: the methods, then the key finding.

msc.topics: Experimental design, econometrics, behavioural decision making, research methods, qualitative research design

A._priorityNote: Bullets citing a priority entry are trimmed for space only after every other non-core bullet.
